original_sql:
SELECT c.claim_id, m.member_name, c.claim_amount
FROM claims c, members m
WHERE c.member_id = m.member_id
  AND c.claim_type = 'AUTO'
  AND c.claim_date >= SYSDATE - 130
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ LEADING(m c) USE_HASH(c) */ c.claim_id, m.member_name, c.claim_amount
FROM claims c, members m
WHERE c.member_id = m.member_id
  AND c.claim_type = :b1
  AND c.claim_date >= :b2
